derived.method: (30,897,450 Class A beneficially owned + 9,444,375 Class B) / (3,564,377,095 Class A + 9,444,375 Class B outstanding at the April 8, 2026 record date) = 1.13%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Caveats: his holdings are as of January 23, 2026 while the share counts are as of April 8, 2026; his Class A figure includes 7,124,993 shares under options exercisable within 60 days and 563,317 shares under stock units vesting within 60 days, which are not in the outstanding count; and it includes shares owned by his spouse, a family charitable foundation and family trusts. Cross-check: proxy footnote 7 says that if he converted his Class B into Class A 'he would beneficially own approximately 1% of the Class A common stock.'

structure.note: Two voting classes. Holders of Class A common stock have 66 2/3% of the voting power and holders of Class B common stock have 33 1/3%, which is generally non-dilutable. Each Class B share has 15 votes; Brian L. Roberts beneficially owns all 9,444,375 Class B shares through a limited liability company of which he is the managing member, giving him 33 1/3% of the combined vote. That is below 50%, so the company is not majority-controlled on these figures. Class B is convertible share for share into Class A.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-26-004994); ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-177138), beneficial ownership as of January 23, 2026. ROBERTS: the proxy gives his Class A stake only as '*' (less than 1% of Class A), his Class B as 100% of the class, and 33 1/3% of combined voting power, so pctVoting is 33.33 and the all-shares figure is the documented derived 1.13% (see derived.method). His 30,897,450 Class A shares include 286,044 owned by his spouse, 1,333,950 owned by a family charitable foundation of which his spouse is a trustee, and 15,772,421 owned by certain family trusts. Relation is 'ceo': the 2026 proxy is signed by him as 'Chairman and Co-CEO' and says that in early 2026 Comcast 'promoted Mike Cavanagh to Co-CEO' and the FY2025 10-K lists Roberts as 'Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer' and says Cavanagh 'has served as Co-Chief Executive Officer since January 2026', so he now shares the CEO role. The 10-K describes him as 'a son of our late founder, Mr. Ralph J. Roberts', not as a founder. HOLDERS: the Vanguard, BlackRock and State Street percentages are of Class A common stock, not of all shares; Class B is 9,444,375 shares against 3,564,377,095 Class A at the record date, so the difference is small, but the figures are not recomputed. BlackRock's figure rests on a Schedule 13G/A reporting holdings as of December 31, 2023 and is stale. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line ($7,155m) includes repurchases under employee plans. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back is $1,288m; Note 13 reports share-based compensation expense of $1,108m. The cash-flow figure is used for consistency with the other records. On January 2, 2026, after the fiscal year, Comcast completed the separation of Versant Media Group (most of its cable networks) into an independent public company (Nasdaq: VSNT); FY2025 figures still include those networks.
